/************************************************************
 * PI COMMERCE — SAFE MERCHANT INFORMATION SYNC
 *
 * Supports:
 * 1. Old sheet format
 * 2. New sheet format
 * 3. New format with an extra blank field
 *
 * Duplicate customer IDs are allowed.
 * The LAST occurrence in the sheet wins.
 *
 * Unknown/misaligned rows STOP the whole sync.
 *
 * Writes directly to Neon in batches of 2,000 (the old single
 * POST to Vercel hit Vercel's 4.5 MB limit -> 413 errors).
 * Needs script property: NEON_DATABASE_URL
 *
 * OUTLETS: every row's MID (the "PizzaW…"-style ID near column B)
 * is also saved with that row's merchant name in merchant_outlets,
 * so a merchant with several outlets under one customer ID shows
 * each outlet's own name on its onboarding case. A missing MID is
 * simply skipped; it never stops the sync.
 ************************************************************/


function normalizeCell(value) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {
    return null;
  }

  if (typeof value === 'number') {
    if (!isFinite(value)) return null;
    return String(Math.trunc(value));
  }

  var s = String(value).trim();
  return s || null;
}


function digitsOnly(value) {
  var s = normalizeCell(value);
  if (!s) return '';
  return String(s).replace(/\D/g, '');
}


function looksLikePhone(value) {
  var d = digitsOnly(value);

  return (
    d.length === 10 ||
    (d.length === 11 && d.charAt(0) === '0') ||
    (d.length === 12 && d.indexOf('91') === 0)
  );
}


function normalizePhone(value) {
  var d = digitsOnly(value);

  if (!d) return null;

  if (d.length === 11 && d.charAt(0) === '0') {
    d = d.substring(1);
  }

  if (d.length === 12 && d.indexOf('91') === 0) {
    d = d.substring(2);
  }

  return d || null;
}


function looksLikeCustomerId(value) {
  var s = normalizeCell(value);
  if (!s) return false;
  return /^\d{5,15}$/.test(s);
}


function looksLikeMcc(value) {
  var s = normalizeCell(value);
  if (!s) return false;
  // Source has valid 3-digit and 4-digit MCCs.
  return /^\d{3,4}$/.test(s);
}


/*
 * MID of a row: letters and digits mixed, 10+ characters (e.g. PizzaW75532028120279).
 * Looked for in column B first, then A and C.
 */
function findMid_(row) {
  var cols = [1, 0, 2];
  for (var i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) {
    var v = normalizeCell(row[cols[i]]);
    if (v && /^[A-Za-z0-9]{10,}$/.test(v) && /[A-Za-z]/.test(v) && /\d/.test(v)) return v;
  }
  return null;
}


/************************************************************
 * FINAL SAFETY CHECK
 ************************************************************/

function isMerchantRecordSafe(record) {
  if (!record) return false;

  if (!record.customer_id || !looksLikeCustomerId(record.customer_id)) {
    return false;
  }

  if (!record.merchant_name) {
    return false;
  }

  if (record.phone_number && !looksLikePhone(record.phone_number)) {
    return false;
  }

  // SMB is merchant type, never category.
  if (record.category && String(record.category).trim().toUpperCase() === 'SMB') {
    return false;
  }

  // Detect customer ID accidentally shifted into sub-category.
  if (record.sub_category && /^\d{5,15}$/.test(String(record.sub_category).trim())) {
    return false;
  }

  return true;
}


/************************************************************
 * DETECT THE THREE KNOWN SOURCE FORMATS
 ************************************************************/

function normalizeMerchantRow(row) {

  // Zero-based: D=3 E=4 F=5 G=6 H=7 I=8 J=9 K=10
  var d = normalizeCell(row[3]);
  var e = normalizeCell(row[4]);
  var f = normalizeCell(row[5]);
  var g = normalizeCell(row[6]);
  var h = normalizeCell(row[7]);
  var i = normalizeCell(row[8]);
  var j = normalizeCell(row[9]);
  var k = normalizeCell(row[10]);

  /***********************
   * FORMAT 1 — OLD
   * D merchant, E phone, F customer ID, G category,
   * H sub-category, I MCC, J SMB
   ***********************/
  if (
    looksLikePhone(e) &&
    looksLikeCustomerId(f) &&
    g &&
    h &&
    looksLikeMcc(i) &&
    String(j || '').toUpperCase() === 'SMB'
  ) {
    var oldRecord = {
      format: 'old',
      customer_id: normalizeCell(f),
      merchant_name: normalizeCell(d),
      phone_number: normalizePhone(e),
      category: normalizeCell(g),
      sub_category: normalizeCell(h)
    };
    return isMerchantRecordSafe(oldRecord) ? oldRecord : null;
  }

  /***********************
   * FORMAT 2 — NEW
   * D merchant, E display name, F phone, G SMB,
   * H customer ID, I category, J sub-category
   ***********************/
  if (
    looksLikePhone(f) &&
    String(g || '').toUpperCase() === 'SMB' &&
    looksLikeCustomerId(h) &&
    i &&
    j
  ) {
    var newRecord = {
      format: 'new',
      customer_id: normalizeCell(h),
      merchant_name: normalizeCell(d),
      phone_number: normalizePhone(f),
      category: normalizeCell(i),
      sub_category: normalizeCell(j)
    };
    return isMerchantRecordSafe(newRecord) ? newRecord : null;
  }

  /***********************
   * FORMAT 3 — NEW + BLANK
   * D merchant, E display name, F blank, G phone, H SMB,
   * I customer ID, J category, K sub-category
   ***********************/
  if (
    !f &&
    looksLikePhone(g) &&
    String(h || '').toUpperCase() === 'SMB' &&
    looksLikeCustomerId(i) &&
    j &&
    k
  ) {
    var shiftedRecord = {
      format: 'new_shifted',
      customer_id: normalizeCell(i),
      merchant_name: normalizeCell(d),
      phone_number: normalizePhone(g),
      category: normalizeCell(j),
      sub_category: normalizeCell(k)
    };
    return isMerchantRecordSafe(shiftedRecord) ? shiftedRecord : null;
  }

  // Unknown structure = never guess.
  return null;
}


/************************************************************
 * BUILD COMPLETE SAFE PAYLOAD
 ************************************************************/

function buildMerchantRows() {

  var spreadsheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  var sheet = spreadsheet.getSheetByName('Onboardings');

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error('Sheet named "Onboardings" not found.');
  }

  var values = sheet.getDataRange().getDisplayValues();

  if (values.length < 2) {
    throw new Error('No merchant rows found in Onboardings.');
  }

  // Keyed by customer ID: a later duplicate replaces an earlier one.
  var byCustomer = {};
  var customerOrder = [];
  var badRows = [];
  // Keyed by MID: each outlet's own name (one customer ID can have many MIDs).
  var byMid = {};

  var oldCount = 0;
  var newCount = 0;
  var shiftedNewCount = 0;
  var duplicateCount = 0;

  for (var r = 1; r < values.length; r++) {

    var sheetRowNumber = r + 1;
    var sourceRow = values[r];

    var allBlank = sourceRow.every(function(value) {
      return String(value || '').trim() === '';
    });

    if (allBlank) {
      continue;
    }

    var merchant = normalizeMerchantRow(sourceRow);

    if (!merchant) {
      badRows.push(sheetRowNumber);
      continue;
    }

    if (byCustomer[merchant.customer_id]) {
      duplicateCount++;
    } else {
      customerOrder.push(merchant.customer_id);
    }

    // IMPORTANT: last occurrence wins.
    byCustomer[merchant.customer_id] = {
      customer_id: merchant.customer_id,
      merchant_name: merchant.merchant_name,
      phone_number: merchant.phone_number,
      category: merchant.category,
      sub_category: merchant.sub_category
    };

    var mid = findMid_(sourceRow);
    if (mid) {
      byMid[mid] = { mid: mid, customer_id: merchant.customer_id, merchant_name: merchant.merchant_name };
    }

    if (merchant.format === 'old') oldCount++;
    if (merchant.format === 'new') newCount++;
    if (merchant.format === 'new_shifted') shiftedNewCount++;
  }

  /***********************
   * SAFETY STOP
   ***********************/
  if (badRows.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      'SYNC STOPPED. ' + badRows.length +
      ' populated rows have an unknown or misaligned structure. ' +
      'Nothing was sent to Neon. ' +
      'Example sheet rows: ' + badRows.slice(0, 25).join(', ')
    );
  }

  var rows = customerOrder.map(function(customerId) {
    return byCustomer[customerId];
  });

  if (rows.length < 100) {
    throw new Error(
      'SYNC STOPPED. Only ' + rows.length +
      ' unique valid merchants were found. Nothing was sent to Neon.'
    );
  }

  return {
    rows: rows,
    outlets: Object.keys(byMid).map(function(m) { return byMid[m]; }),
    oldCount: oldCount,
    newCount: newCount,
    shiftedNewCount: shiftedNewCount,
    duplicateCount: duplicateCount
  };
}


/************************************************************
 * SAFETY CUSTOMER CHECK
 ************************************************************/

function findSafetyCustomer_(rows) {
  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    if (String(rows[i].customer_id) === '1278049194') {
      return rows[i];
    }
  }
  return null;
}


function safetyCustomerIsCorrect_(c) {
  return !!c &&
    c.customer_id === '1278049194' &&
    c.merchant_name === 'SHRI RAM ENERGY STATION' &&
    c.phone_number === '[redacted]' &&
    c.category === 'Gas and Petrol' &&
    c.sub_category === 'IOCL Pump';
}


/************************************************************
 * SAFE PREVIEW — DOES NOT WRITE TO NEON
 ************************************************************/

function previewMerchantInformationSync() {

  var result = buildMerchantRows();

  console.log('==============================');
  console.log('MERCHANT SYNC PREVIEW SUCCESS');
  console.log('==============================');
  console.log('Unique merchants to sync: ' + result.rows.length);
  console.log('Duplicate source rows safely deduplicated: ' + result.duplicateCount);
  console.log('Old-format rows: ' + result.oldCount);
  console.log('New-format rows: ' + result.newCount);
  console.log('Shifted-new rows: ' + result.shiftedNewCount);
  console.log('Outlets (MIDs) found: ' + result.outlets.length);
  console.log('Pizza Wings outlets: ' + JSON.stringify(result.outlets.filter(function(o) { return o.customer_id === '1003024598'; })));

  var testCustomer = findSafetyCustomer_(result.rows);

  console.log('CHECK CUSTOMER 1278049194');
  console.log(JSON.stringify(testCustomer));

  if (!safetyCustomerIsCorrect_(testCustomer)) {
    throw new Error(
      'Preview failed: customer 1278049194 does not map correctly. ' +
      'DO NOT RUN LIVE SYNC.'
    );
  }

  console.log('TEST CUSTOMER IS CORRECT.');
  console.log('PREVIEW PASSED.');
  console.log('NO DATA WAS SENT TO NEON.');
}


/************************************************************
 * NEON CONNECTION
 ************************************************************/

var SYNC_BATCH_SIZE = 2000;

// Stop if the sheet suddenly has 10%+ fewer merchants than the
// last successful sync (protects against a half-pasted sheet).
var MAX_DROP_RATIO = 0.10;


function getNeonUrl_() {
  var cs = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('NEON_DATABASE_URL');
  if (!cs) {
    throw new Error('Missing script property NEON_DATABASE_URL.');
  }
  return cs.trim();
}


/*
 * Runs SQL over Neon's HTTPS endpoint.
 * body = { query, params }              -> one statement
 * body = { queries: [{query, params}] } -> one transaction
 */
function neonSql_(connectionString, body) {
  var afterAt = connectionString.substring(connectionString.lastIndexOf('@') + 1);
  var host = afterAt.split('/')[0].split('?')[0];

  var headers = {
    'Neon-Connection-String': connectionString,
    'Neon-Raw-Text-Output': 'true',
    'Neon-Array-Mode': 'true'
  };

  if (body.queries) {
    headers['Neon-Batch-Isolation-Level'] = 'ReadCommitted';
  }

  var response = UrlFetchApp.fetch('https://' + host + '/sql', {
    method: 'post',
    contentType: 'application/json',
    headers: headers,
    payload: JSON.stringify(body),
    muteHttpExceptions: true
  });

  var code = response.getResponseCode();
  var text = response.getContentText();

  if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
    throw new Error('Neon query failed (' + code + '): ' + text.slice(0, 500));
  }

  return JSON.parse(text);
}


/************************************************************
 * READ-ONLY CONNECTION TEST
 ************************************************************/

function testNeonConnection() {
  var res = neonSql_(getNeonUrl_(), {
    query:
      'SELECT count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE active), ' +
      'max(last_synced_at)::text FROM merchant_information',
    params: []
  });

  var r = res.rows[0];
  console.log('Connected to Neon.');
  console.log('merchant_information total: ' + r[0] +
              ', active: ' + r[1] +
              ', last sync: ' + r[2]);
}


/************************************************************
 * LIVE FULL SYNC
 ************************************************************/

var UPSERT_SQL =
  'INSERT INTO merchant_information ' +
  '(customer_id, merchant_name, phone_number, category, sub_category, active, last_synced_at) ' +
  'SELECT r.customer_id, r.merchant_name, r.phone_number, r.category, r.sub_category, ' +
  'true, $2::timestamptz ' +
  'FROM json_to_recordset($1::json) AS r(' +
  'customer_id text, merchant_name text, phone_number text, category text, sub_category text) ' +
  'ON CONFLICT (customer_id) DO UPDATE SET ' +
  'merchant_name = EXCLUDED.merchant_name, ' +
  'phone_number = EXCLUDED.phone_number, ' +
  'category = EXCLUDED.category, ' +
  'sub_category = EXCLUDED.sub_category, ' +
  'active = true, ' +
  'last_synced_at = EXCLUDED.last_synced_at';

var OUTLETS_SQL =
  'INSERT INTO merchant_outlets (mid, customer_id, merchant_name, synced_at) ' +
  'SELECT r.mid, r.customer_id, r.merchant_name, now() ' +
  'FROM json_to_recordset($1::json) AS r(mid text, customer_id text, merchant_name text) ' +
  'ON CONFLICT (mid) DO UPDATE SET ' +
  'customer_id = EXCLUDED.customer_id, ' +
  'merchant_name = EXCLUDED.merchant_name, ' +
  'synced_at = now()';


function syncMerchantInformation() {
  var cs = getNeonUrl_();

  var result = buildMerchantRows();
  var rows = result.rows;

  if (!safetyCustomerIsCorrect_(findSafetyCustomer_(rows))) {
    throw new Error(
      'LIVE SYNC STOPPED. Safety customer 1278049194 does not map correctly. ' +
      'Nothing was sent to Neon.'
    );
  }

  var sourceName = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getName() + ' / Onboardings';

  // Drop guard
  var last = neonSql_(cs, {
    query:
      "SELECT row_count FROM merchant_sync_runs " +
      "WHERE status = 'success' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1",
    params: []
  });

  if (last.rows.length) {
    var lastCount = parseInt(last.rows[0][0], 10);
    if (rows.length < lastCount * (1 - MAX_DROP_RATIO)) {
      throw new Error(
        'SYNC STOPPED. Sheet has ' + rows.length + ' merchants vs ' + lastCount +
        ' in the last sync. Nothing was sent to Neon.'
      );
    }
  }

  // Upsert in batches
  var runStart = new Date().toISOString();
  var batches = Math.ceil(rows.length / SYNC_BATCH_SIZE);

  console.log('Sending ' + rows.length + ' unique validated merchants in ' +
              batches + ' batches...');

  for (var b = 0; b < batches; b++) {
    var chunk = rows.slice(b * SYNC_BATCH_SIZE, (b + 1) * SYNC_BATCH_SIZE);

    neonSql_(cs, {
      query: UPSERT_SQL,
      params: [JSON.stringify(chunk), runStart]
    });

    console.log('Batch ' + (b + 1) + '/' + batches + ' done (' + chunk.length + ').');
  }

  // Verify every merchant was written before deactivating anyone
  var check = neonSql_(cs, {
    query: 'SELECT count(*) FROM merchant_information WHERE last_synced_at = $1::timestamptz',
    params: [runStart]
  });

  var written = parseInt(check.rows[0][0], 10);

  if (written !== rows.length) {
    throw new Error(
      'SYNC STOPPED BEFORE DEACTIVATION. Expected ' + rows.length +
      ', found ' + written + '. No merchants were deactivated. Run again.'
    );
  }

  // Deactivate merchants no longer in the sheet + log the run (one transaction)
  var finalRes = neonSql_(cs, {
    queries: [
      {
        query:
          'UPDATE merchant_information SET active = false ' +
          'WHERE active AND last_synced_at < $1::timestamptz',
        params: [runStart]
      },
      {
        query:
          'INSERT INTO merchant_sync_runs ' +
          '(started_at, completed_at, row_count, source_name, status) ' +
          "VALUES ($1::timestamptz, now(), $2::int, $3, 'success')",
        params: [runStart, rows.length, sourceName]
      }
    ]
  });

  var deactivated =
    (finalRes.results && finalRes.results[0] && finalRes.results[0].rowCount) || 0;

  // Outlet names per MID. Never stops the merchant sync if it fails.
  var outletsSaved = 0;
  try {
    var outlets = result.outlets;
    for (var o = 0; o < outlets.length; o += SYNC_BATCH_SIZE) {
      var part = outlets.slice(o, o + SYNC_BATCH_SIZE);
      neonSql_(cs, { query: OUTLETS_SQL, params: [JSON.stringify(part)] });
      outletsSaved += part.length;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('Outlet names not saved (merchant sync itself succeeded): ' + err);
  }

  console.log('==============================');
  console.log('MERCHANT SYNC SUCCESS');
  console.log('Upserted ' + rows.length + ' unique merchants.');
  console.log('Marked inactive (no longer in sheet): ' + deactivated);
  console.log('Duplicate sheet rows deduplicated: ' + result.duplicateCount);
  console.log('Outlet names saved (by MID): ' + outletsSaved);
  console.log('==============================');
}


/************************************************************
 * NIGHTLY TRIGGER
 ************************************************************/

function createNightlyTrigger() {

  ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(function(trigger) {
    if (trigger.getHandlerFunction() === 'syncMerchantInformation') {
      ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger);
    }
  });

  ScriptApp
    .newTrigger('syncMerchantInformation')
    .timeBased()
    .atHour(2)
    .nearMinute(30)
    .everyDays(1)
    .create();

  console.log('Nightly merchant sync trigger created.');
}

content.text:
You were right. The doc missed this. The script you pasted loads the **"Onboardings" tab** (in Onboardings_Updated_List) into our database every night. So the full merchant list is stored, and it's a 4th source the doc has to keep.

**Two tabs in that file, two different jobs**

| Tab | Script | Goes to | Status in doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| New | `ad-conversions-sync.gs` | `ad_conversions` | Correctly replaced by SMB Ad Performance Data |
| **Onboardings** | this script (writes directly to Neon, nightly ~2:30) | **`merchant_information`, `merchant_outlets`** | **Missing. Must be added.** |

**Why it matters:** 14 places in the app read `merchant_information`:
- customer lookup and profile (`app/api/customers/lookup`, `customers/[id]`)
- onboarding case list and detail: merchant name, and each outlet's name by MID
- callback requests and WhatsApp (`lib/paytm-callbacks.ts`, `lib/wa.ts`): finding the merchant by phone
- lead gen (`lib/leadgen.ts`): checking whether a lead is already a merchant
- CSM merchant page, voice-AI callback, stale case check

Drop this file and those features lose names and phone matching for every merchant who isn't in Sub Raw.

**Proposed doc section: source 4, Onboardings_Updated_List → Onboardings**

| CSV column | DB column | Transform |
|---|---|---|
| Customer ID (F / H / I, depending on layout) | `merchant_information.customer_id` | 5–15 digits; last duplicate wins |
| Merchant name (D) | `merchant_name` | trim; required |
| Phone (E / F / G) | `phone_number` | last 10 digits (strip 0 / 91) |
| Category | `category` | trim; must not be "SMB" |
| Sub-category | `sub_category` | trim |
| — | `active`, `last_synced_at` | merchants missing from the file are set `active = false` |
| MID (column B, else A or C) | `merchant_outlets.mid` (+ customer_id, merchant_name) | one row per outlet |

The doc also needs to record what the script enforces:
- **Columns are found by position, not header.** It supports 3 layouts (old, new, new with a blank column). Any other row stops the whole sync.
- **Safety checks:**
  - Under 100 merchants: no sync.
  - More than 10% fewer merchants than last run: no sync.
  - Test customer `1278049194` must map exactly, or no sync.

  The CSV load should keep these.
- **Ask for a fixed-header CSV export**, so position detection isn't needed.

Should I update the Google Doc? I'll fix the Replaced line (only the "New" tab is replaced) and add this as source 4.

# **Pi Commerce: Sheets, Scripts and DB Mapping**

*13 Nov 2026*

## **1. What this doc is**

A list of every Google Apps Script we run, what it does, and where its data goes. The database has moved from Neon to AWS (same tables), and the scripts are being switched off. This doc shows what must keep reaching the database once they are gone.

### **Sheets covered**

| :-: | :-: | :-: |
| Sheet | Link | Scripts |
| \\\[MAIN\\\] SMB\\\_Daily\\\_Tracker | \[Open sheet\](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1FtX3WEetElTVxpYwUHOANqovt\_Pk7D8Pz5bCk27unwg/edit) | 1–8 |
| Merchant Callback Request | \[Open sheet\](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/10UnWLchNDFnclfQN\_-pU1XqbzTR0YVXYX24JVrZgeyw/edit?gid=988069928\#gid=988069928) | 9–10 |
| Onboardings\\\_Updated\\\_List | \[Open sheet\](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1MGT1YZB\_w3A5MaInlodvxefCAtZicJcywE0MMMjVdZ0/edit) | 11–15 |
| SMB Ad Performance Data | \[Open sheet\](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Uiq0pxgUYUE\_0-jIfZcAwf3Qf9Av2o1vW9fYDHBiCFQ/edit?gid=0\#gid=0) | 16 |

## **2. How data moves**

**Today:** DaaS report email (CSV) → import script pastes it into a sheet tab → sync script sends the tab to the database (Neon).

**New:** DaaS report (CSV) → loaded straight into a database table (AWS). No sheets, no scripts.

There are two kinds of scripts:

  - **Import script:** copies a CSV from Gmail into a sheet tab. Does not touch the database. Its search line tells us the source report, e.g. subject:"\[Report\] Subscription Raw" → Sub Raw tab. In the new setup, that CSV becomes its own database table.
  - **Sync script:** reads a sheet tab and writes it into database tables. In the new setup, the same columns must land in the same database columns.

All import emails come from [redacted] with subject "\[Report\] …".

## **4.** [**SMB Daily Tracker**](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1FtX3WEetElTVxpYwUHOANqovt_Pk7D8Pz5bCk27unwg/edit)

### **File: Code.gs (scripts 1–6)**

Six import functions. Each one picks the latest DaaS email, clears the tab and pastes the CSV. Nothing goes to the database. In the new setup, each CSV becomes its own table.

### **File: subs raw sync.gs (script 7) · runSubRawOnboardingSync**

**Runs:** daily \~9:30 AM. **Sends to:** /api/internal/sub-raw-onboarding-sync. **Also writes:** one log row to the "Onboarding Sync Log" tab.

**What it does:** for every merchant who subscribed up to yesterday, it creates an onboarding case and assigns an onboarder. If the merchant's ads have already run, the case is closed as Ads Live. If a case was marked Ads Live but no ad actually ran, the case is reopened. From 25 Oct 2026, each outlet (MID) gets its own case.

|  |  |  |
| :-: | :-: | :-: |
| Tab | Sheet column | Database column |
| Sub Raw | merchant\\\_cust\\\_id | onboarding\\\_cases.customer\\\_id |
| Sub Raw | sub\\\_first\\\_date | onboarding\\\_cases.sale\\\_date |
| Sub Raw | subscription\\\_status | onboarding\\\_cases.sub\\\_status |
| Sub Raw | cancelled\\\_at | onboarding\\\_cases.sub\\\_cancelled\\\_at |
| Sub Raw | current\\\_wallet\\\_balance | onboarding\\\_cases.sub\\\_credits |
| Sub Raw | last\\\_completed\\\_stage | onboarding\\\_cases.last\\\_completed\\\_stage |
| Sub Raw | expected\\\_renewal\\\_due\\\_date | onboarding\\\_cases.sub\\\_expiry\\\_date |
| Sub Raw | plan\\\_display\\\_name | onboarding\\\_cases.sub\\\_plan\\\_name |
| Sub Raw | sub\\\_amount (not used today; should be) | onboarding\\\_cases.sub\\\_plan\\\_amount |
| Sub Raw | communication\\\_address | onboarding\\\_cases.sub\\\_state, sub\\\_south |
| Sub Raw | mid | one case per outlet; links CleverTap payments |
| AdsRun Raw | CustID, Ad\\\_Start\\\_Date, Impressions, Spend | onboarding\\\_cases.ads\\\_live\\\_at (first ad date) + "has an ad run?" check |
| meta\\\_failed\\\_ads | ad\\\_id, user\\\_id, reason / error\\\_message | onboarding\\\_cases.ad\\\_fail\\\_reason |

### **File: ads live and cancelled sub.gs (script 8) · runCsmSync**

**Runs:** daily \~9:30 AM. **Sends to:** /api/internal/csm-sync.

**What it does:** sends the full Sub Raw and AdsRun Raw tabs every morning. The app builds the CSM lists from them: Ads About to End, Ads Ended, Cancelled / Expired, Onboarding Lost.

|  |  |  |
| :-: | :-: | :-: |
| Tab | Sheet column | Database column |
| Sub Raw | merchant\\\_cust\\\_id | merchant\\\_subscriptions.customer\\\_id |
| Sub Raw | subscription\\\_status | merchant\\\_subscriptions.status |
| Sub Raw | merchant\\\_name, phone\\\_number, category, sub\\\_category | merchant\\\_subscriptions (same names) |
| Sub Raw | mcc\\\_code | merchant\\\_subscriptions.mcc |
| Sub Raw | sub\\\_first\\\_date, cancelled\\\_at, expected\\\_renewal\\\_due\\\_date, renewal\\\_date | merchant\\\_subscriptions (same names) |
| Sub Raw | completed\\\_ads\\\_count | merchant\\\_subscriptions.completed\\\_ads\\\_count |
| Sub Raw | current\\\_wallet\\\_balance | merchant\\\_subscriptions.wallet\\\_balance |
| AdsRun Raw | CustID | merchant\\\_ads.customer\\\_id |
| AdsRun Raw | Ad\\\_ID | merchant\\\_ads.ad\\\_id |
| AdsRun Raw | Ad\\\_Status | merchant\\\_ads.ad\\\_status |

| AdsRun Raw | Impressions, Clicks, CTR, Reach, Spend, Ad\\\_Budget | merchant\\\_ads.impressions, clicks, ctr, reach, spend, budget |
| AdsRun Raw | Client\\\_ID, MID, Merchant\\\_Name, PhoneNo, Category, Sub\\\_Category | merchant\\\_ads.client\\\_id, mid, merchant\\\_name, phone\\\_number, category, sub\\\_category |
| AdsRun Raw | Ad\\\_Creative\\\_Name, Ad\\\_Description | merchant\\\_ads.creative\\\_name, description |

## **5.** [**Merchant Callback Request**](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/10UnWLchNDFnclfQN_-pU1XqbzTR0YVXYX24JVrZgeyw/edit?gid=988069928#gid=988069928)

### **CallbackCSVFromGmail (script 9)**

Email "callback\_request" → Callbacks tab. Nothing goes to the database.

### **syncPaytmCallbacks (script 10)**

**Runs:** every 3 hours. **Sends to:** /api/internal/paytm-callback-sync.

**What it does:** each merchant who asked for a callback on Paytm shows up in the "Req Call Back" list of the right team (Sales, Onboarding or CSM) and is given to an agent. Only requests from the last 48 hours are taken. A repeat request within 24 hours is counted on the same entry.

|  |  |
| :-: | :-: |
| Sheet column | Database column |
| id | paytm\\\_callback\\\_ids.request\\\_id |
| requested\\\_at | wa\\\_messages.clicked\\\_at |
| phone\\\_number | wa\\\_messages.phone |
| cust\\\_id | wa\\\_messages.customer\\\_id |
| route\\\_to (Sales / Onboarding / CSM) | wa\\\_messages.workspace |
| mid, business\\\_name, stage, reason, subscription\\\_status, ad\\\_live\\\_status, onboarding\\\_stage | wa\\\_messages.variables |

## **6.** [**Onboardings\_Updated\_List**](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1MGT1YZB_w3A5MaInlodvxefCAtZicJcywE0MMMjVdZ0/edit)

### **importOnbCSVFromGmail, importAdsRunCSVFromGmail, importNewAdsCSVFromGmail (scripts 11–13)**

  - **Onboardings** tab: email "Onboardings\_total". New rows are added at the bottom.
  - **Ads\_Run** tab: email "Adsrun\_mail". Tab is replaced each time.
  - **New** tab: email "Onb\_Ads\_New". Existing ads are updated by Ad\_ID, new ads are added. *initialLoadFromDrive* is a one-time full load from a Drive file.

None of these go to the database.

### **syncMerchantInformation (script 14)**

**Runs:** nightly \~2:30 AM. **Sends to:** Neon directly (not through the app).

**What it does:** keeps the master list of merchants (name, phone, category) and their outlets. Merchants no longer in the sheet are marked inactive. This list is used to match leads and callback requests to a customer by phone.

**Important:** this script talks to Neon directly, so it stops working when Neon is switched off. It must be replaced before the switch. The app already has an endpoint for the same job (/api/admin/merchant-sync), used by an older version of this script.

| :-: | :-: |
| Sheet column | Database column |
| merchant\\\_cust\\\_id | merchant\\\_information.customer\\\_id |
| merchant\\\_name | merchant\\\_information.merchant\\\_name |
| phone\\\_number | merchant\\\_information.phone\\\_number |
| category, sub\\\_category | merchant\\\_information.category, sub\\\_category |
| mid, merchant\\\_cust\\\_id, merchant\\\_name | merchant\\\_outlets.mid, customer\\\_id, merchant\\\_name |
| (each run) | merchant\\\_sync\\\_runs (one row per run) |

### **syncAdConversions — old (script 15)**

Same job as script 16, but reads the "New" tab (CustID, Ad\_ID, Ad\_Creative\_Name, Conversations → ad\_conversions). **Replaced by script 16** on the SMB Ad Performance Data sheet. Its trigger should be removed so both don't run.

## **7.** [**SMB Ad Performance Data**](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Uiq0pxgUYUE_0-jIfZcAwf3Qf9Av2o1vW9fYDHBiCFQ/edit?gid=0#gid=0)

### **syncAdConversions (script 16)**

**Runs:** daily \~9:40 AM. **Sends to:** /api/internal/ad-conversions-sync.

**What it does:** saves how many conversations each ad brought in. It uses **adsrun\_ad\_id** (the AdsRun "Ads ID"), not **ad\_id** (Meta's ID), so it matches the ads in AdsRun Raw.

|  |  |
| :-: | :-: |
| Sheet column | Database column |
| customer\\\_id | ad\\\_conversions.customer\\\_id |
| adsrun\\\_ad\\\_id | ad\\\_conversions.ad\\\_id |
| ad\\\_creative\\\_name | ad\\\_conversions.ad\\\_name |
| conversations | ad\\\_conversions.conversions |

### **Rest of the file (45 of 49 columns)**

Only the 4 columns above reach the database today. The file has one row per ad and already contains everything in AdsRun Raw (all 1,507 ads match), plus failed ads and Meta error details. So in the new setup it can also replace the **AdsRun Raw** and **meta\_failed\_ads** tabs.

| :-: | :-: |
| Sheet column | Database column (proposed) |
| customer\\\_id, adsrun\\\_ad\\\_id | merchant\\\_ads.customer\\\_id, ad\\\_id |
| status | merchant\\\_ads.ad\\\_status (running = ACTIVE; completed / off = COMPLETED; error / rejected = failed) |
| impressions, clicks, ctr, spend | merchant\\\_ads (same names) |
| ad\\\_budget | merchant\\\_ads.budget |
| scheduled\\\_start, scheduled\\\_end | merchant\\\_ads.start\\\_date, end\\\_date |
| ad\\\_creative\\\_name, ad\\\_description | merchant\\\_ads.creative\\\_name, description |
| meta\\\_error\\\_message | onboarding\\\_cases.ad\\\_fail\\\_reason |
| all other columns | new table (to decide) |

content.text:
I rechecked every sheet script, every app endpoint that receives data, and every table the app writes. The full list is below. **The CSV mapping doc is missing 2 sources. Everything else is covered.**

## A. Google Sheet scripts (16)

| # | Sheet → Tab | Script (function) | Kind | Goes to DB | Why we fetch it | Status in mapping doc |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | SMB Daily Tracker → OCL Funnel | Code.gs (importCSVFromGmail) | Import | No | Daily funnel report | Not needed (report only) |
| 2 | SMB Daily Tracker → Sub Raw | Code.gs (importSubCSVFromGmail) | Import | No | Brings the subscription CSV in from email | Feeds #7, #8 |
| 3 | SMB Daily Tracker → OCL TP | Code.gs (importOCLCSVFromGmail) | Import | No | Funnel totals report | Not needed |
| 4 | SMB Daily Tracker → Cancellations | Code.gs (importCancelCSVFromGmail) | Import | No | Cancellation report | Not needed |
| 5 | SMB Daily Tracker → Merchant_Funnel | Code.gs (MercFunnelCSVFromGmail) | Import | No | Funnel report | Not needed |
| 6 | SMB Daily Tracker → Scorecard_New | Code.gs (ScorecardCSVFromGmail) | Import | No | Scorecard report | Not needed |
| 7 | SMB Daily Tracker → Sub Raw + AdsRun Raw + meta_failed_ads | subs raw sync.gs (runSubRawOnboardingSync) | Sync | `onboarding_cases`, `onboarding_events`, `customers` | Creates onboarding cases for subscribed merchants; marks Ads Live or reopens | ✅ Source 1 (4.2) + source 2 (4.5) |
| 8 | SMB Daily Tracker → Sub Raw + AdsRun Raw | ads live and cancelled sub.gs (runCsmSync) | Sync | `merchant_subscriptions`, `merchant_ads`, `csm_sync_runs` | Builds the CSM lists: Ads ending, Ended, Cancelled/Expired, Lost | ✅ Source 1 (4.1) + source 2 (4.3) |
| 9 | Merchant Callback Request → Callbacks | CallbackCSVFromGmail | Import | No | Brings callback CSV in | Feeds #10 |
| 10 | Merchant Callback Request → Callbacks | syncPaytmCallbacks | Sync | `wa_messages`, `paytm_callback_ids` | "Req Call Back" list per team | ✅ Source 3 (4.6) |
| 11 | Onboardings_Updated_List → Onboardings | importOnbCSVFromGmail | Import | No | Brings the full merchant list in | Feeds #14 |
| 12 | Onboardings_Updated_List → Ads_Run | importAdsRunCSVFromGmail | Import | No | Not read by any sync | Not needed |
| 13 | Onboardings_Updated_List → New | importNewAdsCSVFromGmail | Import | No | Feeds #15 | Not needed |
| **14** | **Onboardings_Updated_List → Onboardings** | **syncMerchantInformation** | Sync (**direct to Neon**) | **`merchant_information`, `merchant_outlets`, `merchant_sync_runs`** | Master list of every merchant (name, phone, category, outlets). Used to match callbacks, leads and WhatsApp to a merchant by phone, and to name outlets on cases | ❌ **Missing. Wrongly marked "not required".** |
| 15 | Onboardings_Updated_List → New | syncAdConversions (old) | Sync | `ad_conversions` | Conversations per ad | ✅ Replaced by #16. Remove its trigger. |
| 16 | SMB Ad Performance Data → All customers | syncAdConversions | Sync | `ad_conversions` | Conversations per ad | ✅ Source 2 (4.3–4.5) |

## B. Not Google Sheets, but data still comes in

| Source | Entry point | Goes to | Why | Status in mapping doc |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Meta lead form sheet** | `leadgen-sync.gs` → `/api/internal/leadgen-sync` (every 5 min) | `leadgen_leads`, `leadgen_meta_ids` | New, unpaid leads for Sales | ❌ **Marked "out of scope"**. It still dies when the scripts are retired. Needs an owner. |
| CleverTap payment webhook | `/api/internal/ct-payment` | `ct_payment_events`, `onboarding_cases.sold_by_employee_code` | Who sold the subscription; payment events | Live webhook, not CSV. Only the URL needs repointing to AWS. |
| Voice AI callback | `/api/internal/voice-ai-callback` | call results | AI call outcomes | Webhook, same as above |
| Agents in the CRM | UI routes | `external_leads`, rosters, `seller_roles`, dispositions, notes | Typed in by agents | No source needed |
